Deliberate boundaries

Useful questions.
Honest unknowns.

  • Useful-task efficiency, not just token prices.Quality and failed attempts belong in the denominator.
  • Evidence-conditional company research.Anthropic is an anchor, not a proxy for the whole sector.
  • Operational impacts, with place and boundaries.No company-energy totals inferred from revenue.
  • Contestable scenarios, not investment forecasts.Future results must retain assumptions and provenance.

What this draft does—and does not—claim

The author approved the specification and plan on November 28, 2026. The paper is published here as a review draft. Filing passages are located and internally checked, but origin authentication, financial review, calibrated models and analytical release still require their evidence and review gates. The rebound lab adds only illustrative, uncalibrated indexed scenarios.

Located filing values appear with their verification state; none is verified. No provider rankings, calibrated or stochastic results, or impact estimates are shown.
